model_part.description: The model part to transform. Must be one of: `head`, `hat`, `body`, `rightarm`, `leftarm`, `rightleg`, `leftleg`
model_part.markdownDescription: The model part to transform. Must be one of: `head`, `hat`, `body`, `rightarm`, `leftarm`, `rightleg`, `leftleg`

type.description: The type of transformation. Must be one of: `pitch`, `yaw`, `roll`, `visible`, `hidden`, `xscale`, `yscale`, `zscale`, `pivotx`, `pivoty`, `pivotz`
type.markdownDescription: The type of transformation. Must be one of: `pitch`, `yaw`, `roll`, `visible`, `hidden`, `xscale`, `yscale`, `zscale`, `pivotx`, `pivoty`, `pivotz`

value.description: The amount to transform. For rotations (pitch/yaw/roll): degrees. For positions (pivotx/pivoty/pivotz): units. For scale (xscale/yscale/zscale): multiplier (added to base scale of 1.0). For visibility (visible/hidden): `1` for true/visible, `0` for false/hidden.
value.markdownDescription: The amount to transform. For rotations (pitch/yaw/roll): degrees. For positions (pivotx/pivoty/pivotz): units. For scale (xscale/yscale/zscale): multiplier (added to base scale of 1.0). For visibility (visible/hidden): `1` for true/visible, `0` for false/hidden.

override_animation.description: When `true`, locks the specified rotation (pitch, yaw, or roll) to the exact value, preventing vanilla animations from affecting that rotation on that body part. When `false` or omitted, the transformation is additive and vanilla animations can still affect the part.
override_animation.markdownDescription: When `true`, locks the specified rotation (pitch, yaw, or roll) to the exact value, preventing vanilla animations from affecting that rotation on that body part. When `false` or omitted, the transformation is additive and vanilla animations can still affect the part.
